Audit Trail

View the immutable audit trail of all data changes. Verify chain integrity and investigate modifications.

audit

Audit integrity verification and forensic investigation router.

This module exposes three endpoints for proving non-repudiation of the SHA-256 chained forensic audit log:

  1. POST /verify-integrity — Runs a full-chain verification sweep that recalculates every entry’s hash and compares it against the stored value. Returns an audit certificate suitable for sovereign security compliance boards.

  2. GET /entities/{entity_id}/history — Returns the complete chronological forensic timeline for any entity (PortfolioNode, DependencyLink, ResourceAssignment, etc.), showing who modified what, from which IP, and under which security caveats.

  3. GET /export-signed-ledger — Streams a digitally signed ZIP archive containing the full audit ledger, verification certificate, SHA-256 manifest, and signature file.

Access Control

All endpoints require JWT authentication via get_current_user(). These are administrative endpoints intended for use by security compliance officers and internal auditors.

Endpoints

  • POST /api/v1/audit/verify-integrity — Full-chain verification sweep.

  • GET /api/v1/audit/entities/{entity_id}/history — Entity forensic timeline.

  • GET /api/v1/audit/export-signed-ledger — Signed audit bundle download.
